objective: Produce a bounded portfolio of exactly three fresh, unverified structural SSI proposals without reopening the FC0/CollimationSieve lane or admitting an Executor.

candidates.title: Fresh structural-mechanism portfolio for surviving supersingular assumptions
candidates.uncertainty: Whether three mutually distinct structural objects can produce falsifiable, non-duplicative proposal-stage mechanisms against the EndRing/path, CSIDH class-group-action, or auxiliary-structure barriers without repeating a closed or gated lane.
candidates.positive_decision: Snapshot exactly three unverified proposals for later independent novelty and technical review; do not create a hypothesis, approve a protocol, or admit an Executor.
candidates.negative_decision: Record only that this bounded portfolio could not produce three compliant disjoint proposals; retain the open questions and do not revive the excluded FC0 or closed routes.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record an incomplete or source-limited portfolio as proposal-stage inconclusive; no cryptanalytic inference follows.

ambiguities.question: Whether the reported p^(1/4) path baselines apply to a proposed object.
ambiguities.resolution: Each idea must state its exact problem and field setting, compare only when applicable, and otherwise say that no matched exponent comparison is available.
ambiguities.basis: KN-LIT-078 and KN-LIT-079 are setting-specific reported baseline context.

ambiguities.question: Whether a portfolio mechanism is genuinely absent from prior program work.
ambiguities.resolution: Screen all named exclusion records and relevant corpus material, label novelty unverified, and return the idea for revision if it is a renamed route.

candidates.dominated_by: No attack or frontier point is claimed at proposal stage; any future mechanism must compare itself against the applicable reported baseline before selection.

sota_delta.note: This batch creates proposals only and asserts no algorithmic improvement.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A snapshot-archived, schema-complete set of exactly three mutually distinct proposal records with explicit objects, null controls, falsification routes, Pareto fields, and proof maps where applicable.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: If any required proposal field, non-duplication boundary, or source qualification is missing, no proposal is interpreted as a result and the portfolio remains incomplete.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: An unsupported novelty, literature, asymptotic, or cost statement is labelled unverified or unknown rather than repaired from inference.
peripheral_exclusions: Host-pin, toy-width, fake-tau, or stopping-trace-collision work
Any experiment, protocol approval, hypothesis creation, or Executor task
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The final five-path idea-portfolio snapshot is accepted by the post-commit verifier.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Structured novelty screening and schema-complete proposal authoring.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: No mathematical or cryptanalytic complexity result is measured; this is bounded research-design work.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: Serial only: control snapshot, then one Idea Generator portfolio producer, then one portfolio snapshot.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop at exactly three compliant ideas or report incompleteness; do not add a fourth route or relaunch an excluded route.

stages.purpose: Archive the exact control plane before any ideation producer reads it.
stages.stop_rule: Stop unless the archive verifier accepts every declared source path plus receipt.

stages.purpose: Generate exactly three mutually distinct, schema-complete unverified proposal records.
stages.dominant_operation: Object-first mechanism design, novelty screen, and falsifiability specification.
stages.stop_rule: Stop at exactly three compliant ideas; missing required content is incomplete, not filled by the Coordinator.

stages.purpose: Archive the five exact portfolio source paths before any later review or selection.
stages.stop_rule: Stop unless the archive verifier accepts the five source paths plus receipt.
